# antigravity-priority v1.2.17-en.2

Fork release on top of v1.2.17-en.1. Fixes how the plugin writes credentials and reacts to rate limits, plus three page fixes. Scheduling and priority planning are unchanged.

- **Token refreshes are no longer overwritten.** If CPA refreshed an account's OAuth token while the plugin was writing that account's priority, the write could put back the old token. The plugin now re-reads the credential file just before replacing it. If the file changed, it applies the priority and disabled values to the new contents. If someone else changed the priority or disabled value in the meantime, the write is reported as a conflict and the file is left alone.
- **429 cooldown is stricter.** A request now counts as rate-limited only on HTTP 429 or a structured `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` / rate-limit error code. A failure whose message merely contains the text "429" no longer demotes the account.
- **No cooldowns while the plugin is disabled.** With `enabled: false`, rate limits are no longer tracked and accounts are never demoted. The cooldown still works when `auto_apply` is off, as before.
- **Clean startup.** Loading the plugin no longer reads or writes the state cache, and no background worker is left over from a second initialisation. All of that now starts when CPA initialises the plugin.
- **No light flash in dark mode.** The page picks up CPAMC's theme before its first paint, so dark-theme users no longer see a light frame while it loads.
- **History details fit on phones.** On narrow screens the comparison in a run's details stacks into one card per account instead of being cut off.
- **Safer account buttons.** The Probe and Samples buttons on each account card keep working when an email address contains quotes or other special characters.
